fields.label: 1. State your full names
2. State your address (Permanent address is preferable).
3. What is the name of your proposed partner(s)?
4. State the permanent address of your proposed partner.
5. What is the name of the business?
6. What is the address of the business?
7. Describe briefly the nature of the business.
8. Is the business registered at the Corporate Affairs Commission?
If not, by what means is it registered?.
9. Do you have a limited time frame for the Partnership to last?
10. How much or what percentage do you intend to contribute to the capital of the business?
11. How much or what percentage of the capital is your partner willing to contribute to the business capital?
12. How much or what percentage of the net income of the business are you willing to have?
13. How much or what percentage of the net income of the business is your proposed partner entitled to?
14. What percentage or amount of net loss and liability is your proposed partner entitled to?
15. What duration would you prefer to be your accounting year?
fields.placeholder: (ie one calendar year or six months)

fields.label: 16. Do you have an existing partnership account?
17. What is the name of the bank in charge of the partnership account?
18. What is the signature mandate for accessing funds from the Partnership account?
19. Will your proposed partner be equally involved in the daily running and decision making of the business?
20. Do you intend to include subsequent partners into the business in the future?
21. Who decides who will include a subsequent partner in the future?
